name: AE Employer Election Drill-Down
description: Per-employer 2026 vs 2027 Annual Enrollment comparison. Meant to sit beside a native SAC Input Control (bound to Employer_Name via Linked Analysis): with no employer selected, shows a needs-attention list sorted by size and completion; with one selected, shows a full year-over-year comparison card.

feeds.description: Employer_Name / Synod_Region / Eligible_Band / Status_2027 / Status_2026 / Contribution_Set_2027 / Contribution_Set_2026 / Health_Plan_Bundle_2027, from AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_YOY (built on GLD_AE_Employer_Enrollment_YoY, one row per employer). Status_2026 uses a different, unreconciled vocabulary than Status_2027 -- shown as-is, not mapped. Bind this widget's model, then filter it via a native Input Control on Employer_Name (Tools -> Link Dimensions) -- no selection shows a needs-attention list, one selection shows a full comparison card.

Employee_Count_2027, Employee_Count_2026, Eligible_Count_2027, HSA_Single_2027, HSA_Family_2027, HSA_One_Time_Single_2027, HSA_One_Time_Family_2027, HSA_Single_2026, HSA_Family_2026, HSA_One_Time_Single_2026, HSA_One_Time_Family_2026 -- in that exact order

refresh.description: Re-renders the widget from the currently bound data
